data.content: Blender Next is a Git-backed visual layout engine for Next.js 16 (Turbopack), React 19, and monorepos. Instead of syncing schemas between database dashboards and front-end code, Blender Next uses Zod schemas as the source of truth and stores layouts as flat JSON files in Git.
